name: Span folding drying rack
intro: Room for the wet things. Room back when they are dry.
description: A freestanding laundry rack with two independently folding wings and replaceable beech rails. Made for households that air-dry part of each load and put the rack away between washes.

accessory.name: Flat-dry mesh
accessory.description: One removable mesh shelf for a sweater; fits either size. Its load counts toward the rack limit.

delivery.dispatch: In-stock orders dispatch in 3–5 business days. Delivery time varies by address.

care: Wipe steel with a damp cloth and dry it.
Allow beech rails to dry before folding.
Use indoors on a level floor; neither a seat nor a climbing frame.
repair: Individual rails and end caps can be requested through the local inquiry preview. Replacement part prices are not supplied; do not invent them.

policies.returns: 30 days after delivery, unused, in original packaging. Return postage paid by buyer.
policies.warranty: Two-year manufacturing-defect warranty; ordinary wear and misuse excluded.
policies.tax: Prices and estimates exclude applicable tax; this demo does not calculate tax.

faq.q: Will it hold a full wash?
faq.a: Line length and load limits describe capacity. A machine-load claim would depend on garment size and fabric, so we do not make one.

faq.q: Can I leave one wing down?
faq.a: Yes. Either wing can fold independently. Spread wet items evenly and stay within the total load limit.
It is intended for indoor use. Unfinished beech should not be left in rain.

inquiryNotice: Local preview only. Nothing has been sent, reserved, or purchased.
